reviews.title: App Did Not Perform as Expected- Refund Request Denied
reviews.text: I purchased Cleaner Guru specifically to merge duplicate contacts, but the app did not perform that function as represented. It never merged the contacts and always locked up.  I canceled my subscription and subsequently received an additional charge.  I submitted multiple refund requests through Apple and explained the circumstances, but each request was denied without a specific explanation.  I also made several attempts to obtain assistance and received automated responses or no response.  Based on the app’s performance, the subscription and the lack of meaningful customer support, I cannot and would not recommend Cleaner Guru.  Customers should carefully review the subscription terms and verify that the app performs the needed functions before purchasing.

reviews.title: Not worth even downloading the app
reviews.text:
Cleaner Guru is one of the most overpriced apps I’ve ever downloaded. The weekly subscription cost is absurd and ends up being more expensive than paying for actual cloud storage services that provide far more value. Charging users every week for basic phone cleaning features feels excessive and difficult to justify.

The app may work as advertised, but the pricing model completely ruins the experience. For the cost of a few weeks of Cleaner Guru, you can get significantly more storage and functionality from major cloud providers. The value simply isn’t there.

Unless the subscription pricing is dramatically reduced or a reasonably priced one-time purchase option is offered, I cannot recommend this app. There are much better alternatives available that don’t require such an expensive recurring weekly fee.

On top the app is super slow for even look for the data used in you phone.
